verdict.rationale: CrewAI's entire product is built around defining Agents and delegating Tasks to them (and agents can delegate tasks among each other when allowed), with Crews orchestrating collaborative task execution and even a no-code Crew Studio for building/delegating without code. This is corroborated by hands-on community use (a crew built to categorize emails, draft responses, and send Slack alerts) in addition to first-party docs. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark/UX review specifically evaluating delegation reliability, and Crew Studio (no-code assistant builder) is gated behind the paid AMP tier rather than the open-source core.
